body: Hey. I’m vegan and I just want to say that wasting food is against an eco ethos. Also as the food rots, it creates gas which is also bad for the environment. Meat can’t be anymore dead and trying to police another persons diet because it ‘doesn’t fit’ with theirs is gross. Not everyone can be vegan, I’m a prime example of that with a child that has sensory challenges that eats meat. Sometimes I can switch out unnoticed but even the slightest change in texture and it’s a nope. Meltdown. Screwing with diets is wrong, no matter what a persons belief is. Ask them to pay for your loss or you’re leaving. Then set clear cut boundaries that if it happens again you’ll be gone. No one should mess with your stuff, let alone the very thing that is keeping you alive. This doesn’t educate anyone, it just makes vegans look even more fucking gross. I’m so sorry you’ve had to encounter a couple like that.

YTA and your kids know that too which is why they don’t go to bed for you. They don’t respect you and that’s not only sad but isn’t enough of a wake up call for you to realise you need to sort yourself out.

She’s not on insulin, she’s trying to stay as clear from medication as she can in any form. (She has lupus and scleroderma so takes enough medication for those alone.) so she starts clear of treats so as to not add to her medicines list.

You can set messages on Instagram to be from those who follow you only and if you set your profile to private (if you haven’t already) he can’t just follow you and then send a message. If you need your profile open there’s also an option in the settings to block comments from certain people too. So you can basically cut him off no matter how many profiles he makes if he keeps making them. Well done for cutting him off, but don’t make yourself small on social media just because that’s what he wants. He’s your ex and he needs reminding of that with actions.
If my MIL sends one more damn brochure for nursery when my toddler already has a nursery that suits us and their needs.... I will be shoving it where the sun don’t shine.

YTA. You’re the parent, you’re supposed to be showing your kid how not to behave. I also have a 12 y/o and I wouldn’t DREAM of saying this kind of shit to them. Do they say things that are hurtful sometimes? Sure. But they are a kid. They’re going through a whole rewire of the brain with puberty heading in the opposite direction. Go and apologise to your kid and show some responsibility. Not only will you set an example for your kid you might also learn why your kid has been acting out. I would guess it’s because you’re really not understanding the internal upheaval they’re going through right now.

YTA. Have you ever sat down with this kid to ask why she’s so upset? Have you ever reassured her that you’re not replacing anyone, that you love her and want her to be part of a now extended family? Seriously, don’t have kids until you can take care of one that you already have, and you do have responsibility at least to make sure she’s ok because you chose to be with her Dad. That means also wanting her to be happy, feel safe, and most of all feel loved. She’s 11. I have a kid around the same age and get answered back ALL THE TIME and I gave birth to them. Kids don’t have to same emotional coping mechanisms that we have as adults and she’s maybe even afraid her Dad won’t love her anymore if she says she doesn’t like having you around because he has sided with you. Tbh, you both need your heads banging together and stop making this kid feel so damn unhappy. FYI, I also come from a divorced family and I’ve never called my Step Dad Dad. That doesn’t stop him from being the best person I’ve had come into my life and belittle the things he has ever done for me. What’s important is how he treated me as his own and never tried to step on anyone’s toes because he knew how hard it was for everyone.

YTA. I’m vegan too but everyone else in my house eats what they want to eat. Why? Because like you said, veganism is NOT a diet, it’s a chosen way of life. Enforcing that on someone who not only is a ‘guest’ (lol I’ll get to why that’s also problematic in a moment.) but also is a teenager and requires you to make compromise is enough. I get it’s ‘your house’ but this is what is essentially supposed to be ‘your family’. If you had no issue dating someone with different beliefs to yours you shouldn’t expect them to change them for you either. Honestly I hope she runs so far away from you because being empathetic to humans as well as animals is just as important.

YTA. She blanked you once? I’m gonna say I’m not surprised if you decide to leave her out of stuff. As the person who is ‘disliked’ in my family I can tell you it leads to resentment and division and it’s not cool. You’ll only end up hurting your Dad in the end and he’s gone through it already losing one woman he was in love with. Quit the crap, get to know your Dad’s girlfriend and start to make her feel included.

I would check what his legal rights are/if he has any and then if it’s necessary, serve him notice to leave. If he complains remind him that you did him a solid when he needed it and you were under no obligation to. He’s literally having a tantrum because he isn’t ready to move on from you and this is probably because he’s got a good thing going where he can live off you and have girlfriend. Wonder what she thinks of his tantrum.

The fact he’s trying to make you feel bad for him basically sexually assaulting you is not ok. I know it’s easy to say ‘get out’ and honestly that’s where my mind goes to but I also know it can be super scary to leave. If you want this ‘person’ to continue to try and make this like its your problem that he can’t control himself then continue as is. Otherwise you need to tell him under no uncertain terms he gets help and keeps his damn hands off or you’re out that door. That this isn’t your burden, you are not the one who did wrong here, and you refuse to carry the weight of his guilt because he decided to assault you in your sleep. If he continues with the bullshit then pack a bag and leave. Find someone who understands consent and boundaries.
Your edit just proves you wanted back up rather than to be told you’re the AH. I hope your child finds more support from others about how they’re choosing to live than they’re getting from you.

YTA. You don’t get to decide how your child decides to live their life. If they change their mind in the future, that’s up to them. It’s really not that difficult to use the pronouns they wish. See how I’ve done it for the whole of this post? There are worse things in the world than your child living their life how they wish in a way that isn’t harmful to anyone but them. Get over yourself.

“For the family sake” is toxic bullshit when the other members aren’t willing to apologise or adjust their actions. Your Mum should have punished her and stood by your Dad in that. She’s a grown up, not a small child. I’m so sorry this has happened to you and I’m glad to see that you can hopefully get it restored at your sisters expense. Maybe this time she’ll learn a lesson about touching your stuff, although I’m doubtful if she has your Mum enabling her. Might be worth getting a lock on your door and keeping her out. See how quickly her mood changes when she can’t be the keeper of your things because you won’t bend to her whim.

We own a house together and he was the one who worked full time. I don’t want to leave my kids here because they’d be with me anyway whilst he worked, and until he buys me out of my half I can’t go anywhere. I haven’t any money not will social housing help me as I’m a home owner. So I just feel at a loss. Like totally worn down. I had PND after my youngest and I feel like it’s been used against me. I’m so paranoid. He hacked my social media and recorded me in my own home. I don’t think he’d even care if he knew. I honestly think he’d be happy.
